podcast.title: Guest Vocals on Crossover Hit (1986)
podcast.body: Steven Tyler provided guest vocals on Run-DMC's 1986 cover of "Walk This Way," lending his voice to rap's first big pop crossover hit, a collaboration instrumental in its widespread success. "featuring guest vocals and guitar from Aerosmith's own Steven Tyler"

podcast.title: Attended UK Classic Rock Awards
podcast.body: Steven Tyler was among the notable musicians present at the UK Classic Rock Awards, where The Trews were nominated for "Best New Band." He was referred to as one of the "insane giants from the Classic Rock world" at the event. "Stephen Tyler was there and all these insane giants from the Classic Rock world were there."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Trews: In Their Own Words

xref.title: Classic Rock Magazine Support
xref.body: Classic Rock magazine in the UK has been consistently supportive of The Trews. They nominated the band for a "best new band" award for their second album at the UK Classic Rock Awards, where band members attended alongside figures like Jimmy Page and Steven Tyler. The magazine also reviewed their records and interviewed them regularly. "they nominated us for an award on our second album, like a best new band award at the UK Classic Rock Awards."
